items.item: The header shows the delivery note number, issue date, source sales order or transfer number and dispatching warehouse, each with a visible label, and every date on the note uses one unambiguous format (such as 06 Nov 2026)
items.evidence: Header table has 'Delivery Note No.' (DN-2026-04871), 'Date of Dispatch' (07 Nov 2026, unambiguous format, and the only date on the page), and 'Order Reference' (PO-55214-A), but there is no 'Dispatching Warehouse' field anywhere in the header — the only warehouse mention is 'Warehouse 3, Riverside Industrial Estate' buried inside the Sender address block with no field label.

items.item: Sender (company name, address, tax ID), recipient (customer name, delivery address, contact person and phone) and carrier (carrier name, vehicle plate or driver name) appear in three separately labelled blocks
items.evidence: Info is scattered across five labelled boxes instead of three: 'SENDER / DISPATCHED FROM' (h3.text-xs.font-bold, no tax ID — VAT Reg No. GB 745 2291 06 only appears in the unrelated page header), 'CUSTOMER / BILL TO' (name only), a separate 'DELIVERY ADDRESS' box (address + Contact: M. Osei — +44 113 244 8820), and separate 'CARRIER' and 'DRIVER' boxes in the shipping strip.

items.item: The goods are in a real <table> with column headers in <thead>, giving per line: line number, item code, description, unit of measure, quantity ordered, quantity delivered and lot or serial number, with quantities right-aligned
items.evidence: <table class="w-full border-collapse"><thead><tr>...<th>#</th><th>SKU / Item Code</th><th>Description</th><th class="text-right">Qty Ordered</th><th class="text-right">Qty Shipped</th><th>Unit</th><th>Batch / Lot</th></tr></thead> with matching <td class="text-right"> cells for both quantity columns in every row.

items.item: A line delivered short of the ordered quantity states the outstanding amount in words (such as "Backorder: 4 pcs") rather than by colour alone
items.evidence: Row 3 (500 ordered / 480 shipped) has no colour coding at all, but the note below the table reads: 'Note: Item 3 (Corrugated Shipping Box) shipped at 480 of 480 units confirmed in stock; remaining 20 units on backorder, to follow on DN-2026-04889.' — a textual statement of the outstanding quantity.

items.item: A footer gives the total quantity delivered, the number of packages and the gross weight with its unit, and the quantity total equals the sum of the lines
items.evidence: <tfoot> gives 'Total Line Items: 5', ordered total 706 and shipped total 686 (120+60+480+24+2=686, correct sum). Package count ('14 cartons / 2 pallets') appears only in a separate 'NO. OF PACKAGES' box above the table, not in a footer total. No gross weight or weight unit appears anywhere on the page.

items.item: Signature boxes are provided for the warehouse keeper (issued by), the driver or carrier and the receiver, each with room for printed name, signature and date, plus a remarks area for the condition of the goods on receipt
items.evidence: Only two signature boxes exist: 'DISPATCHED BY' and 'RECEIVED BY (CUSTOMER)', each with Signature/Printed Name/Date/Time fields, and the receiver box includes 'Condition of Goods on Receipt (notes)'. There is no third signature box for the driver/carrier.

items.item: A Print control that is a real <button> starts printing, and an @media print stylesheet hides the app navigation and on-screen controls, sets page margins and keeps the signature block from splitting across pages
items.evidence: <button onclick="window.print()">Print / Save as PDF</button> is a real button, and `@media print{ .no-print{display:none!important} .page{box-shadow:none!important;margin:0!important} @page{size:A4;margin:12mm} }` hides the nav bar and sets margins, but there is no `break-inside: avoid` (or equivalent) rule anywhere protecting the signature grid from splitting across a page boundary.

items.item: The note's status (such as Draft, Dispatched, Delivered or Cancelled) is shown in words next to its number, and a draft or cancelled note prints with a visible "DRAFT" or "CANCELLED" mark so it cannot pass as a valid dispatch document
items.evidence: No status field exists anywhere on the page — the header table only lists Delivery Note No., Date of Dispatch, Order Reference and Route/Load No.; there is no Draft/Dispatched/Delivered/Cancelled label or watermark.

items.item: A loading state is present, and a note that fails to load or does not exist shows a message with Retry and a link back to the delivery note list, never an empty template with blank fields
items.evidence: The page is a static print template with all data hard-coded in markup; the only script is a Ctrl/Cmd+P keydown handler calling window.print(). There is no fetch/loading logic, no error state, no Retry control and no link back to a delivery note list.

notes: This is a static, hard-coded print-preview mockup with no data-loading, error, or status logic implemented. Primary structural gaps: no dispatching-warehouse field, no gross weight, no driver/carrier signature box, no status/DRAFT-CANCELLED marking, and the print stylesheet doesn't protect the signature block from page-break splitting. The 'NH' logo tile (rounded-md bg-slate-800 with initials) is a company logo, not a person, but visually reads as an initials-avatar tell.
